notes: Corrected the proposed upper endpoint: body initializes the output pointer in incoming x0 to zero (41022-41023), queries selector 0x13 and continues only for status 4 (41024-41028), loads the 32-bit word via the global-object path at 0x7004650000+0x998+0xc (41038-41042), subtracts 0x83, then sets output to one only when the difference is less than 0x17 because CC_CS is unsigned >= in runtime/core/cpu.h:234-264 (41043-41045). Thus the true range is 0x83 through 0x99 inclusive; the proposal’s 0x9a endpoint is off by one and its “x3” description is incorrect. The only indexed caller is a transparent tailcall wrapper preserving x0 (main_0016.c:52859-52861).

Sampled blank remains unnamed. The body requires selector 0x13 status 4 (main_0116.c:29995-29999), then probes keys 0x87..0x99 with boolean lookups and associated value fetches, tracking a candidate key and finally returning that key through validate_selector_and_lookup_code or -2 (main_0116.c:30000-30248). Caller sites pass an output-slot pointer and store the returned code (main_0113.c:7168-7169; also main_0113.c:32772-32773), but do not reveal what the key/code represents. The selection predicate and domain meaning remain unresolved, so no semantic label is supported.
